signUp.description: Who can make an account (USR-2, SIGN_UP).

smtpUrl.description: Email through an SMTP server: smtp://user:password@host:587 or smtps://…:465. A secret: never sent back (SMTP_URL). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

mailFrom.description: The sender, "LawFive <lawfive@example.com>" (MAIL_FROM). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

mapStyleUrl.description: A MapLibre style for the map, or off for raster tiles (MAP_STYLE_URL). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

mapStyleDarkUrl.description: The style for dark mode (MAP_STYLE_DARK_URL). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

mapStyleAttribution.description: The style's credit, as HTML (MAP_STYLE_ATTRIBUTION). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

mapTileUrl.description: Raster tiles, with {z}, {x} and {y} (MAP_TILE_URL). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

mapAttribution.description: The tiles' credit, as HTML (MAP_ATTRIBUTION). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

mapSatelliteUrl.description: Satellite tiles, with the provider's key (MAP_SATELLITE_URL). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

mapSatelliteAttribution.description: Their credit, as HTML (MAP_SATELLITE_ATTRIBUTION). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

geocoderUrl.description: Address search (Nominatim-compatible), or off (GEOCODER_URL). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

weatherUrl.description: Forecasts (Open-Meteo-compatible), or off (WEATHER_URL). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

weatherHistoryUrl.description: Past weather for played matches, or off (WEATHER_HISTORY_URL). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

weatherApiKey.description: For a paid plan. A secret: never sent back (WEATHER_API_KEY). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

weatherDailyLimit.description: Weather calls a day at most (WEATHER_DAILY_LIMIT). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

webhookAllowPrivate.description: true lets webhooks reach private and local addresses (WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE). null or "" clears it, back to the default.

description: Settings for the whole server that admins change in the web app (ADM-1, ADM-2), sending only those that change. One the environment sets is fixed there and can't be changed.
